findings.title: Error stack leaked to the client
findings.message: err.stack is sent in a response and can leak internals.
findings.remediation: Log the stack server-side and send a generic error body to the client.

findings.title: Vulnerable dependency brace-expansion@1.1.11
findings.message: brace-expansion@1.1.11 is affected by GHSA-3jxr-9vmj-r5cp (brace-expansion: DoS via exponential-time expansion of consecutive non-expanding {} groups).
findings.remediation: Upgrade brace-expansion to 5.0.7 or later (data from OSV).

fix.diff:
--- a/package.json
+++ b/package.json
# bump brace-expansion from 1.1.11 to 5.0.7
